correctness.rationale: Itô isometry gives exact strictly convex regression risk. Positive weights follow from the tridiagonal inverse Brownian covariance M-matrix. Boundary, zero and duplicate samples admit strict improving perturbations; interior knot and weight FOCs force equal coefficients, the unique feasible quadratic root, and a closed risk. Analytic infinite-n quantifier is proved for every integer n, not extrapolated from tests.
